messages.author: 4a344f0b5d9a00f2
messages.subject: ggplot broken confidence bands
parts:
Could anyone advise how to fix the broken confidence bands in ggplot (see attached figure).   The gaps in the confidence bands are not where the NA data are. 
Thank you very much in advance.

Dirk


>   a <- ggplot(data = dataplot, aes(Year, AgeAdjusted), color = Race.Ethnicity)
>   a <- a + geom_point(aes(color = Race.Ethnicity, shape = Race.Ethnicity),
+                       size = 7,
+                       alpha = 0.75)
>   a <- a + geom_smooth(aes(color = Race.Ethnicity), 
+                        se = TRUE, 
+                        span = 0.8,
+                        fullrange = FALSE)
>   a <- a + xlab('\nCalendar Year')
>   a <- a + ylab('5-Year Relative Survival\n')
>   a <- a + labs(title = "")
>   a <- a + theme_bw() 
>   a <- a + theme(legend.position='none')
>   a <- a + ylim(0,100)
>   a <- a + scale_color_manual(values=c('blue','darkred'))
>   a <- a + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=45, angle=0, colour='black'))
>   a <- a + theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=45, angle=0, colour='black'))
>   a <- a + theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=45, angle=90, colour='black'))
>   a <- a + theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=45, angle=0, colour='black'))
>   a <- a + theme(plot.title = element_text(size=45))  
>   a <- a + theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size=35, vjust = 1))
>   a <- a + theme(strip.background = element_blank())
>   a <- a + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) 
>   print(a)
`geom_smooth()` using method = 'loess'
Warning messages:
1: Removed 3 rows containing non-finite values (stat_smooth). 
2: Removed 3 rows containing missing values (geom_point).

messages.subject: Re: ggplot broken confidence bands
parts:
Try it with and without it - you'll see the difference. To cut it off at zero use coord_cartesian:
a <- a + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100))
